description: Return the most recent finished screen recording: the narration aligned to keyframes, the on-screen UI elements captured with each frame, and the frame images. This is the one to call when the user says "look at what I just recorded" or refers to feedback they gave out loud.

include_images.description: Attach keyframe images (default true). Set false for the text timeline only.

name: get_latest_session
title: Get the latest narrated session
